internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: Divine makr must not inherit human moral blame; participant authority changes justice, not the structural covert counter-arrangement.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The root means evil deception; divine counter-plots and neutral structural description refute built-in moral evil.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinct from planning generally because the arrangement is hidden from or turns upon a target.
internal_discovery.rationale: Covert outcome-arrangement is universal; moral polarity is cleanly participant/context-derived.
